discussion.body:
Separate log: Nyxara the Hollow Flame (Temple of Fire / Maze Fissure). Face three of three. No living mask. No new undead plate.
Copied existing plates, not reuploaded. The form study already is the true body: no human flesh, hollow cracked anatomy, ember core. A second undead pass would duplicate it.
Locals: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-002-nyxara-form-study.jpg. Existing clothed/form plates stay. No status change. HEAD not moved.
